scope.time_attribution: Actor call time is assigned once to the first segment stage. Later segments in the same fixed plan have zero additional invocation time. Env dispatch time belongs to each complete applied segment.
scope.actor_time_scope: public input staging plus Docker/CLI/session/network/service wait/generation/result parse; not model-internal inference time
scope.score_partial_segment_rule: Only physics step counts are clipped at the first score boundary. No actor or dispatch wall duration is interpolated inside a segment.

separate_completed_full_run_context.residual_scope: initialization, shutdown including the extra neutral transition, orchestration and other unmetered time together; not isolated startup or elapsed time to ACK252
